drafts.release_notes:
# entireio/cli v0.11.4

Changes since v0.11.3, released 2026-10-06.

## New

- Add hidden `entire checkpoint create` for snapshot checkpoints
- Add interactive wizard to `entire repo create`
- Enable report: require a known upstream host, not a non-native forge
- Add interactive wizard to `entire project create`
- Enable report: a native repo has no upstream forge URL to report
- Name project and repo grantees
- Name org members, from a refreshed core spec
- Let each provider own how its handles are spelled

## Fixed

- Validate adopted task transcript paths
- Keep the forge on semantic lookups and the startup scope in the TUI
- Resolve commit SHAs in cross-repo checkpoint explain (ENT-2102)
- Keep the origin failure's cause in the default-scope error
- Derive the default scope from the origin's forge, not a GitHub-only check
- Only import sessions that belong to this repository
- Address review findings on grantee display names
- Split OPF spans that cross a batch separator instead of dropping them
- Reject Go-only escapes in double-quoted trust keys
- Accept single-quoted TOML keys in hook trust check
- Never display a Google handle that names another account
- Keep the wire handle in auth status --json user
- Rebuild Google's handle prefix canonically, never fold the id

## Docs

- Trails reach a native repo by ULID, not "not at all"

## Also in this release

- Suggest --repos only where the flag is accepted
- Clarify trail findings check in CLAUDE.md
- Match repo paths by identity and fail closed on a bad trust file
- Let session attach link a commit without rewriting it
- Address review on the review trust gate
- Close the review gaps in repo-scoped discovery
- Document the review trust gate
- Ask before reviewing code someone else wrote
- Recognise pre-commit's wrapper however it quotes --hook-type
- Stop uninstalling a hook whose .legacy restore failed
- Lock by hooks directory, not by repository
- Tell every reviewer the code under review is untrusted
- Take the hook path back after pre-commit install
- Never lose a hook when a backup already exists
- Say an existing hook still runs after enable, and restore it on uninstall
- Address a checkout by its origin's forge, not GitHub by assumption
- Keep discussion ETags out of project trail comment JSON
- Deduplicate project trail resolution and reuse shared helpers
- Point the delete command's short help at closing
- Turn trail delete into an error pointing at close
- Focus first-turn agent guidance on project trails
- Start each session's claims window at its turn's start
- Accept successful approval responses without decoding unused bodies
- Point the e2e sweep at the verb that still exists
- Keep upstream repository create tests scoped to the legacy constructor

_Draft from the git history. Edit before you publish._
